gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma IDH (Isocitrate Dehydrogenase) Wildtype; Glioblastom WHO Grade 4
Supratentorial IDH-wildtype glioblastoma located in the frontal, temporal, or occipital lobe with EGFR gene mutation

candidate_evidence.quote: mRNA vaccine: GV-907、GV-108: Eligible patients will receive intradermal injections of cancer vaccines

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: complete tumor resection confirmed by imaging within 10 days after initial surgery, followed by standard radiotherapy and/or chemotherapy; no tumor recurrence observed on MRI at 4 months postoperatively.

role_evidence.quote: This study evaluates the safety and specific antitumor immune responses of mRNA vaccines GV-108 and GV-907 in IDH-wildtype glioblastoma patients.

coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). Only interventions are two mRNA cancer vaccines (excluded type), so S6 fails. EGFR mutation is an entry requirement and is probably the vaccine antigen target, but vaccines are not candidates, so candidate_matched false. Three sequential dose-level arms; no control arm. Antigen-specific T-cell response is a vaccine immunogenicity endpoint, not candidate target engagement.
